meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览、检查并渲染视频,本地或云端批量出片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用命令行搭建视频分镜并批量渲染成片。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build storyboards and render videos in batches from the command line.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令替你建项目、写合成、跑 lint 和 check 检查、打开预览,并且只在你说可以之后才渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提到 HyperFrames 视频项目的创建、编辑或渲染,或需要诊断构建、渲染失败时,它会接管;validate、inspect、layout 已废弃,请改用 check。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes 初始化一个新视频项目
say.note: 会执行 npx hyperframes init 搭脚手架

say.text: 跑一下 check,看看这个合成有什么问题
say.note: check 会先跑 lint,再开浏览器审查

say.text: 先用 draft 质量渲染一版给我看看
say.note: 迭代阶段用 --quality draft 快速出片

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI: it scaffolds projects with npx hyperframes init, searches the catalog, authors compositions, runs lint and check, opens the Studio preview, and renders a video only after you approve.
howto.when_en: Use it when you mention creating, editing, or rendering a HyperFrames video project, or when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check.

say_en.text: Initialize a new HyperFrames video project for me.
say_en.note: Runs npx hyperframes init to scaffold it.

say_en.text: Run check on my composition and show what's wrong.
say_en.note: check runs lint first, then audits in a browser.

say_en.text: Render a draft-quality version so I can see it.
